new_learnings.text: Geopolitical shock days (US-Iran strikes + oil spike) validate the hard buy gate: breadth 0.21:1, 0/3 indices green, f10=49 — staying in cash prevents opening positions that would be underwater within hours. The objective gate removes emotional 'buy the dip' impulses.
new_learnings.mechanism: When all three major indices are red and breadth is below 0.5:1, sector-level analysis becomes irrelevant — systemic risk dominates. The buy gate is a circuit breaker that prevents deploying capital into a falling knife.

new_learnings.text: Sector gravity confirmed again: 上海新阳 (电子化学品 #1) +6.37%, 路维光电 (半导体 adjacent) +4.44% both green today, while 恒铭达 (消费电子 neutral) -1.17% and -4.43% today. Hot sector stocks hold up in selloffs; neutral-sector stocks don't.
new_learnings.mechanism: In risk-off tapes, money concentrates in the strongest themes (semiconductor materials,小金属) and abandons everything else. Stocks in persistent hot sectors benefit from institutional rotation INTO them as safe havens within equities.

new_learnings.text: Volume below MAVOL30 (恒铭达 at 61%) combined with negative price action (-4.43%) is a reliable early warning before stop-loss triggers. The volume rule correctly flagged weakening momentum before the stop was threatened.
new_learnings.mechanism: Low volume on down days means no buyers are stepping in to absorb selling. Combined with price below MA5/MA10, it signals distribution rather than healthy consolidation. This pattern often precedes stop-loss triggers by 1-3 days.

new_learnings.text: 金钼股份 and 新宙邦 are the top candidates to buy when the market regime clears. Both have: (a) sector in top 5, (b) fresh catalysts (钼价 +35.65% YTD; 宁德时代电解液大单), (c) healthy MA distances, (d) institutional backing. Pre-identifying these reduces decision latency when the buy gate reopens.
new_learnings.mechanism: Having a pre-vetted 'on-deck' list eliminates FOMO-driven decisions when the market turns. The discipline is: wait for breadth ≥1.5:1 + ≥2 indices green, then immediately assess the on-deck list rather than scanning the full pool.
